plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand logo opens, the phone anchors the product beside a large one-line headline, the NEW FLAVOR sticker sits between message and action, and a well-padded CTA closes on the right.
Product-first lockup: the phone with its NEW FLAVOR sticker leads at the left, the headline holds the wide centre, and the logo is paired with the CTA as a brand sign-off on the right.

Message-led with the product as the closing visual: logo and headline read first from the left, the CTA follows directly after the headline, and the phone with its sticker (top-right, as in the original) bookends the right edge.
